views.name: sales_transactions_with_year
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  h.salesorderid AS sale_transaction_id,
  h.salespersonid AS salesperson_id,
  h.orderdate AS sale_date,
  CAST(strftime('%Y', h.orderdate) AS INTEGER) AS sale_year,
  h.totaldue AS sale_amount
FROM salesorderheader h
views.description: All individual sales transactions normalized with a calendar year extracted from the sale date and canonical salesperson identifier. Keep monetary amount as a numeric value suitable for aggregation.

views.name: annual_sales_per_salesperson
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  stwy.salesperson_id AS salesperson_id,
  stwy.sale_year AS year,
  SUM(stwy.sale_amount) AS annual_total_sales
FROM
  sales_transactions_with_year stwy
GROUP BY
  stwy.salesperson_id,
  stwy.sale_year
views.description: Aggregate total sales amount per salesperson per calendar year by summing sale_amount across transactions in that year.

views.name: annual_quotas_per_salesperson
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  SalesPersonQuotaHistory.BusinessEntityID AS salesperson_id,
  CAST(strftime('%Y', SalesPersonQuotaHistory.QuotaDate) AS INTEGER) AS year,
  SalesPersonQuotaHistory.SalesQuota AS annual_quota,
  SalesPersonQuotaHistory.QuotaDate AS quota_date,
  SalesPersonQuotaHistory.rowguid AS rowguid,
  SalesPersonQuotaHistory.ModifiedDate AS modified_date
FROM SalesPersonQuotaHistory
views.description: Quota records normalized to one row per salesperson per year, with the quota amount and a year value (either from an explicit quota year field or derived as provided by schema). Include all quota records even if no sales exist that year.

views.name: sales_vs_quota_by_year
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(s.salesperson_id, q.salesperson_id) AS salesperson_id,
  COALESCE(s.year, q.year) AS year,
  COALESCE(s.annual_total_sales, 0.0) AS annual_total_sales,
  q.annual_quota AS annual_quota,
  COALESCE(s.annual_total_sales, 0.0) - q.annual_quota AS difference
FROM annual_sales_per_salesperson s
FULL OUTER JOIN annual_quotas_per_salesperson q
  ON s.salesperson_id = q.salesperson_id AND s.year = q.year
views.description: Full outer join (or union-style combine) of annual_sales_per_salesperson and annual_quotas_per_salesperson to produce one row per salesperson per year present in either source, with NULLs filled as zero or left null as appropriate; compute the difference as annual_total_sales - annual_quota.
